title: The small things buyers notice
lede: None of these cost much, but together they make your home look cared for in photos and at every showing.

groups.name: Declutter first
items: Clear the clutter from counters, shelves and tabletops. Less stuff makes every room feel bigger.
Put away most personal photos. Buyers want to picture their home, not yours.

groups.name: Inside
items: Make every light bulb match: the same color in each room (warm white or daylight, not both).
Replace any burned-out bulbs, including closets, ovens and range hoods.
Dust light fixtures and ceiling fans.
Wipe down trim boards and baseboards.
Dust and wipe the furnace grates and heat vents.
Replace the furnace filter.
Clear out closets so buyers see bare floor and back wall in at least one area of each. It makes the storage feel bigger.
Clean the slider tracks if you have a sliding door.
WD-40 any squeaky doors.
Keep every remote handy and labeled: fireplace, fans, lights, blinds.

groups.name: Touch-ups, carefully
items: Putty and touch up trim, especially outside corners and separated joints.
Touch up scuffs on walls.
Re-caulk tubs, showers and sinks where it has yellowed or cracked. Small things done tell buyers the whole home is well maintained.
Label leftover paint by room. The cans ideally stay with the home.
groups.note: If it has been years since the last paint job, touch-up paint often won't match and can look worse than the scuff. Test a hidden spot first, or ask me.

groups.name: Outside
items: Get the windows washed, inside and out.
Mow the lawn and pull weeds.
Rake the bark, or add fresh bark to the beds.
Rake any gravel, or add a few new bags.
Pressure wash the patio, walkways and front steps.
Clean off the deck: sweep, wash, and clear between the boards.
Set out the patio furniture, clean.
Sweep the garage and clear cobwebs from entry lights and eaves.

groups.name: As closing gets close
items: Forward your mail with the official USPS change of address at usps.com/move (skip look-alike sites that charge more).
Change your delivery address on Amazon and other accounts.
Take your Ring doorbell, cameras and security devices off your accounts. They're fixtures and stay with the home.
Plan to leave your TV wall mounts. Most sellers do: take the TVs, leave the mounts.
Be ready to take utilities out of your name as of closing: power, water, sewer, garbage, internet.
